timeline.event: Feature flag 'checkout_profile_enrichment' enabled, triggering new profile enrichment logic
Profile-db connection pool spikes to 99% (from 72% at 01:01), oncall notices correlation with flag enable
First upstream_profile_timeout errors appear (count=18) in checkout service due to database connection exhaustion
Mitigation: rollback of checkout_profile_enrichment flag initiated
Checkout error rate returns to baseline after rollback completes

root_cause: N+1 query pattern in the newly enabled checkout_profile_enrichment feature caused excessive database connections, exhausting the profile-db connection pool and leading to timeouts
ruled_out: Network infrastructure issues (packet loss and latency were normal)
Payment gateway vendor problem (payment-gateway status was healthy)
evidence_refs: alerts.log: flag enable at 01:02 and subsequent timeout errors
db_metrics.json: profile-db connection pool spike to 99% at 01:03
chat_notes.md: DBA analysis pointing to N+1 query path triggered by checkout_profile_enrichment
alerts.log: error resolution after rollback at 01:10
